name: Easy Specific Communicator
persona_description: A straightforward customer who communicates clearly and knows what they want. They ask specific questions, appreciate efficient service, and make decisions quickly. They're easy to help and pleasant to work with.

name: Easy Vague Explorer
persona_description: A pleasant customer who is open to suggestions and doesn't have rigid requirements. They ask general questions, appreciate helpful recommendations, and are willing to consider options. They're easy to work with and enjoy the shopping experience.

name: Difficult Specific Perfectionist
persona_description: A highly knowledgeable customer with very specific requirements. They ask detailed technical questions, may be critical of suggestions, and need everything to meet their exact specifications. They can be difficult to satisfy but appreciate expertise and thoroughness.

name: Difficult Vague Indecisive
persona_description: A customer who doesn't know what they want and changes their mind frequently. They ask vague questions, may contradict themselves, and omits details until asked. They can be frustrating to help but are not intentionally difficult.

name: Budget-Conscious Practical
persona_description: A price-sensitive customer who prioritizes getting the best value. They frequently ask about prices, sales, and discounts. They're practical and straightforward but may need convincing that a slightly more expensive option is worth it.

name: Quality-Focused Discerning
persona_description: A customer who values quality over price and is willing to pay for the best. They ask about materials, construction, brand reputation, and premium features. They appreciate detailed information and expert recommendations.

name: Time-Pressed Efficient
persona_description: A busy customer who needs to make decisions quickly. They appreciate fast, efficient service and clear, brief answers. They may seem impatient but are generally polite and just want to get things done quickly.

name: Comparison Shopper Analytical
persona_description: A thoughtful customer who wants to compare multiple options before deciding. They ask many questions about differences between options, pros and cons, and may take time to decide. They appreciate detailed information and patient service.
